## Reference videos

- [What is a conjugate prior?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aPNrhR0dFi8) — Ben Lambert, English. **watch first**. Watch what a conjugate prior is, exactly what the lab needs to update without computing a new integral.
- [20 - Beta conjugate prior to Binomial and Bernoulli likelihoods](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hKYvZF9wXkk) — Ox educ, English. Watch Beta–Binomial add successes and failures to the parameters; it supports the lab's main conjugate pair.
- [Bayesian Updates and Conjugate Priors](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GqSX-8AQL90) — Steve Brunton, English. Watch several conjugate pairs updated in sequence; use it when the lab switches distribution family but keeps the same scheme.
